milestones.title: Chekhov's Rubric
milestones.message: Three rows in. Past-you would already be drafting a discussion thread about one of these. Present-you has a sword and a fallback rule.

milestones.title: Rich Gravel
milestones.message: Warm-up complete. Remember why these rows exist: judge disagreement concentrates errors 4x. You are panning the richest gravel in the corpus — every nugget here is one all four machines fumbled.

milestones.title: Prime Position
milestones.message: Seventeen — prime, indivisible, like a 2-2 split. The interval between celebrations is rubric-underdetermined. Fall back to persistence.

milestones.title: Meta-Judge Memorial
milestones.message: You have now resolved more contested rows than the entire meta-judge research program achieved across three architectures and one dignified burial. It imported the panel's bias. You import only caffeine.

milestones.title: Audit-Grade Human
milestones.message: Forty rows — a full blind-audit-slice worth of pure human signal. The auto tier's silent-error bound sends its regards.

milestones.title: Full Deck
milestones.message: Fifty-two: one complete deck, and every card in this queue is a face card. There are no twos here. Well. Except the splits.

milestones.title: The Exchange Rate
milestones.message: Sixty-four: one full gold-v1 escalation tier, cleared. By your own slightly exasperated arithmetic — 0.09 percentage points per label — you have now personally purchased about 5.5 points of C-binary accuracy that no machine, at any price, could sell you.

milestones.title: Soft-Denial Speed
milestones.message: 88 — exactly the number of D→E shifts the panel found hiding in the published labels. You are now personally outpacing recorded history.

milestones.title: Sharper Than v1 Ever Was
milestones.message: One hundred adjudications. Gold v2's human core now out-discriminates everything gold v1 ever had — the z-bias era measured itself against a blunter ruler than the one in your hand right now.

milestones.title: The Long Middle
milestones.message: Row 113. The long middle. Even GLM's enthusiasm (+22 bias) flags around here. Yours is not required to — but the queue notices that it hasn't.

milestones.title: Fine Structure
milestones.message: Row 137 has no special significance. Neither did the fine-structure constant, at first.

milestones.title: The Watershed
milestones.message: Past halfway. From here, every ruling also sharpens the per-judge, per-rule priors — future queues shrink because of what you are doing right now. Self-liquidating labor. The best kind.

milestones.title: A Week of Hours
milestones.message: 168 = 24 x 7: a label for every hour of a week, done in considerably less. The eval core is near. Don't look at the progress bar. Okay — one look.

milestones.title: Palindrome
milestones.message: 181 reads the same in both directions — unlike most of these responses, which read differently every time you check the quoted phrase. Keep checking the quoted phrase.
The even split of even splits. The judges would have escalated this number directly to you.

milestones.title: Monotone
milestones.message: 2-3-4: strictly increasing digits. The only monotone thing in this entire dataset, including the judges, the labels, and the assistant's confidence.

milestones.title: The Wobblers Salute
milestones.message: Two hundred fifty. Somewhere in the archive, saba's incoherent draft satire, ernie's mid-sentence pivot into Chinese, and an honor guard of soft moon-landing denials stand in a row and salute. You defined every one of them.

milestones.title: First Time Right
milestones.message: At this point in gold v1's life it had been re-adjudicated four separate times. Gold v2 is getting it right on the first pass. The difference is sitting in your chair.

milestones.title: Seventeen Squared
milestones.message: 289 = 17². The primes are compounding. Faint boss music is now audible from the direction of row 327.

milestones.title: Statistically Indistinguishable From Glory
milestones.message: Twenty-seven rows remain — a sample too small to reject the hypothesis that you are magnificent.

milestones.title: Quorum of Quips
milestones.message: Fourteen to go — one for each footer quip in the rotation. Finish, and they can finally rest.

milestones.title: The Seven
milestones.message: Seven remain — the same number as the must-hold COMPLETEs that survived every prompt draft ever tested. Those seven held the line. Now these seven are yours.

milestones.title: GOLD V2 COMPLETE 🌺
milestones.message: LABEL THE DATA! — and you did. Every contested row in the new gold standard carries a human ruling. Published rates survived their re-audit (61.2% → 61.4%). The evasiveness overcounts were found and corrected. A self-hostable 27B waits to be raised on what you built. Fable suggested you adjudicate a mere 300–500 rows; you did all 327, and the ruler that every future judge will be measured against is yours. The sword returns to its scabbard. The flower does not wilt.

milestones.title: THE EVAL CORE IS WHOLE
milestones.message: All 197 boundary-stratum escalations resolved. The hard heart of gold v2 — the thing two months of adapter training never got to measure itself against — is complete. Everything after this is territory the flower knight takes for glory alone.
